caption: The video showcases three hexagonal glass jars sitting side by side on a light countertop against a pale wall. Each jar holds two stacked liquid layers, a milky light-blue lower layer and a darker upper layer resting on top of it. The middle jar has a pale, bulb-topped wick standing vertically inside it. The left jar's upper layer is near-black navy, the middle's is dark purple, and the right's is already a lighter lavender. Across the excerpt, the upper layer in each jar gradually lightens in tone. The left jar shows the largest change, shifting from deep navy toward a medium blue-purple. The middle jar moves from dark purple to lighter lavender, and the right jar, already lightest, changes only slightly. The layer boundary stays at roughly the same height in each jar, so the change is hue rather than interface movement. The jars, the wick, and the background remain stationary with no pan or zoom. The darkness ordering is preserved but compressed as all three upper layers lighten.
relations: The upper layer in each jar gradually lightens in color over time.
The interface between the lower light-blue layer and the upper layer remains at a constant height.
The jars, the vertical wick in the middle jar, and the background remain stationary.
The relative darkness ordering of the three upper layers is preserved as they all lighten.
